caption:
One torn paper bag and a runaway baguette. 🥖

This looks exactly like real home footage, and it's 100% AI.
prompt:
use seedance 2.5 for this

VIDEO PROMPT — 15 seconds · 16:9 landscape · ultra-realistic candid home-video look: filmed by a friend walking behind her on a handheld camera (not a selfie), slightly soft image, muted faded colors, low contrast, mild vignette, flat grey overcast morning daylight, natural skin texture · camera feel: imperfect handheld with small shakes, quick reframes and brief autofocus hunting · pacing: real-time, spontaneous, a small funny accident, 5 shots

CHARACTER (identical in every shot): a naturally pretty Korean woman, about 24, fair skin, long straight jet-black hair worn loose past her shoulders with a few wispy face-framing strands, minimal makeup, soft friendly face. Oversized dark maroon (burgundy) hoodie with the hood down, matching loose maroon sweatpants, chunky white sneakers. She carries a tall brown paper bakery bag with one long golden baguette inside, its crusty tip sticking out of the top.

LOCATION: a quiet, narrow Parisian side street in the early morning: cream limestone Haussmann-style apartment buildings with tall windows, white shutters and black iron basement grilles on the right, a wide grey stone-flagstone sidewalk with metal drain covers, a cobblestone road on the left lined with parked grey and silver hatchback cars, a raised stone curb with a wet, puddled gutter. Nobody else around.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:03.2) — The walk. Medium-wide handheld shot from behind and slightly to her left, following her at walking pace along the sidewalk, buildings on the right, parked cars and the long street receding on the left. She holds the paper bag against her front with the baguette tip poking up at her left side. At 00:01.8 the bottom of the bag gives way and the baguette slides straight down out of it; at 00:02.5 she twists and grabs at it, too late; the camera lurches and blurs as she spins round.

SHOT 2 (00:03.2-00:05.8) — The drop. Low ground-level close shot, camera just above the flagstones. The baguette hits the pavement flat with a soft thud, wobbles and rolls across the uneven stone slabs toward the camera. At 00:04.5 her white sneakers and maroon sweatpants hurry into frame from the right; at 00:05.0 her foot lands right beside the baguette, nudging it, and it tumbles end-over-end away from her. Handheld, fast, motion blur.

SHOT 3 (00:05.8-00:08.8) — The chase. Low wide shot from ground level looking down the sidewalk along the curb, parked grey hatchbacks on the left. The baguette bounces over a black metal drain cover, keeps rolling diagonally toward the curb and drops off it into the wet gutter beside a parked car. From 00:07.5 she runs into frame from the right (legs, maroon pants, white sneakers) chasing it and reaching down at 00:08.5. Camera follows low and shaky.

SHOT 4 (00:08.8-00:10.3) — The lunge. Low-angle medium shot from behind and to the side. She makes a clumsy playful lunge, bending almost into a crawl on the curb, one leg stretched out behind her, long hair falling forward over her face, and grabs the baguette out of the gutter puddle with both hands, staying bent over.

SHOT 5 (00:10.3-00:15.1) — The rescue. Handheld medium shot from behind her right shoulder, slightly crooked framing. She straightens up and stuffs the baguette back into the torn paper bag, facing away down the street (blue shopfront shutters and parked cars in the background). At 00:12.0 she turns her head back toward the camera over her shoulder, an embarrassed, amused smile, then laughs naturally and, at 00:14.5, hugs the bag and baguette tight against her hoodie like she rescued something precious. Camera drifts slightly closer and settles.

SOUND: no music, no narration. Quiet early-morning street ambience, her footsteps, paper bag rustling, a soft paper tear, the baguette's hollow thud on stone, light rolling and tapping on the flagstones, a small splash in the gutter, quick hurried footsteps, her surprised little gasp "Ah!", then her genuine soft laugh at the end.

Physics: real gravity and friction, continuous real-time motion, natural human movement; no slow motion, no floating, no duplicated baguettes, no cartoon reactions.
prompt_short: Realistic handheld home video, overcast Paris side street: a young Korean woman in an oversized maroon hoodie walks with a paper bag; the baguette slips out, rolls down the sidewalk into the gutter, she lunges, rescues it, turns and laughs. No music.
